source.title: Antidiabetic activity of flower buds of  Michelia champaca  Linn
source.limitation: Laboratory flower-bud extraction and rat experiments only. Not a stem-bark method, human diabetes treatment, safe dose or beginner home recipe.

proposal.preparationPart: Flower buds; not stem bark, leaves or fragrance oil
proposal.preparationDescription: An independent study of Michelia champaca (Magnolia champaca) dried and powdered flower buds, compared solvent extracts with a separate boiled-water extract, and vacuum-concentrated the extracts for Wistar-rat experiments. This laboratory description is not a home recipe or treatment and supplies no validated human diabetes dose. The quarantined stem-bark source is not used; its unresolved metadata is not a confirmed retraction finding.

reviewGaps: Human plant-part safety and clinical efficacy remain uncleared.
No household quantities, boiling duration, daily frequency or medicinal dose is derived from laboratory/rat parameters.
Category, genuine reviewer, import/rollback/concurrency and final source/photo clearance remain pending.
